scope: Ten semantic findings discovered by independent synthetic forward cases; not an exhaustive domain certification

findings.initial_failure: CDD repeated the same monetary source fact in additional receipt rows
findings.repair: Reject duplicated observed monetary provenance at intake
findings.final_replay_status: bounded current-contract replay passed; original and incomplete-intake expectations retained separately

findings.initial_failure: Multiple documents for one economic event increased corroborated proceeds
findings.repair: Require sourced economic-event identity and applicable scoped additivity; count identified event once, withhold absent/conflicting evidence
findings.final_replay_status: bounded current-contract replay passed; original and incomplete-intake expectations retained separately

findings.initial_failure: Approval after first use covered preceding promotion interval

findings.initial_failure: An earlier positive retest obscured unresolved later failure at criterion level

findings.initial_failure: Immediate obligation required a fixed due date before trigger assessment

findings.initial_failure: One obligation evidence gap contaminated later obligation state

findings.initial_failure: A missing classification hid a known actor/scope mismatch

findings.initial_failure: An access-only mandate accepted embedded list-change proposals

findings.initial_failure: An event numerator and customer denominator appeared compatible

findings.initial_failure: Floating JSON parsing shortened a long threshold and reversed exact one-third comparison

findings.final_replay_status: bounded current-contract replay passed; original and incomplete-intake expectations retained separately

companion_schema_repairs: Typed source-fact values must permit source-bound booleans, objects, lists and other advertised native values
Output schemas must allow valid partial nulls while preserving strict authority/context constants
Optional unused I2 execution_context matches native contract
historical_evidence: Original inputs, pre-run expectations, failed outputs and executable snapshots are retained; intake amendments saved separately
